'''Kanika T'dell''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who<ref name="paragon" /> in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]<ref name="Date">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Paragon]]'' states that Kanika T'dell served aboard the ''[[Omen]]'' during the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|attack]] that led to the destruction of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. The attack appeared in a flashback sequence in ''[[Crosscurrent]]'', which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].</ref> served as a [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] [[Cadet/Legends|cadet]] aboard the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Omen]]'' during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].<ref name="paragon" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the ''Omen'' was knocked off course during [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump after a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|attack]], and crashed in a [[Takara Mountains|mountain range]] on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]].<ref name="precipice">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]''</ref> T'dell survived the disaster, and eventually they and the other remaining ''Omen'' crewmembers found their way to civilization where they took over rule of the planet.<ref name="paragon" />

Around [[4992 BBY]],<ref name="Age">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Paragon]]'' states that [[Ebya T'dell]] was seven [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old in [[4985 BBY]], dating her [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]] year to around [[4992 BBY]].</ref> T'dell had a daughter, [[Ebya T'dell|Ebya]], with another Human survivor, a [[Mining/Legends|miner]] named [[Nafjan T'dell]]. The T'dell parents were acquainted with [[Seelah Korsin]], a prominent member of the Kesh Sith [[Lost Tribe of Sith|society]] who, in [[4985 BBY]], examined Ebya to determine whether she would be allowed to [[Reproduction/Legends|reproduce]].<ref name="paragon" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kanika T'dell was mentioned by [[John Jackson Miller]]'s [[2010]] [[eBook]], ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Paragon]]''.<ref name="paragon" />
